summary: The submission comprises a methodology text describing the use of Claude Code and Python tools to process 31 PDFs, and a detailed Task 1 inventory report. The methodology outlines the execution of all five required tasks—inventory, topographical mapping, divergence analysis, integrative synthesis, and final report—while the Task 1 document provides the full inventory and initial scan. AI assistance is explicitly declared via Claude Code.
issues: Only the Task 1 report is provided as a full document; deliverables for Tasks 2‑5 are described but not included.
